title: Rest the mind on what already carries it
summary: God is named as the breath of the soul and the support of the mind. Rest begins when praise answers that support instead of the mind pretending to carry itself.
takeaway: Let praise answer the One already holding the breath.
lifeApplication: At the sink, desk, or bedside, notice that the next breath arrives before you earn it. Whisper one line of praise from that dependence, then continue from support rather than strain.

source.shortMeaning: The soul breathes by God's support, and devotees live by singing the Infinite One's praises.
source.lifeApplication: When the mind overworks, return to the breath as received support and answer it with praise.

evidence.coreClaim: The soul breathes by God's support, and devotees live by singing the Infinite One's praises.
evidence.turn: The mind steadies when it stops treating support as self-made and lets praise become its way of living.
evidence.practicalImplication: At the sink, desk, or bedside, notice that the next breath arrives before you earn it. Whisper one line of praise from that dependence, then continue from support rather than strain.
